native.query: SELECT o.id, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.created_at, p.name, pr.title FROM orders o LEFT JOIN people p ON o.user_id = p.id LEFT JOIN products pr ON o.product_id = pr.id

result_metadata.name: user_id
result_metadata.description: The user who made this order.

result_metadata.name: name
result_metadata.description: The name of the user who owns an account.

result_metadata.name: title
result_metadata.description: The name of the product as displayed to customers.
